name: Cypress Towne Center
summary: Cypress Towne Center is an open-air shopping center along US Highway 290 in Houston's affluent Cypress area, featuring 279,210 square feet of national retailers, restaurants, and services. Shadow-anchored by Target, the center serves one of northwest Houston's fastest-growing and most prosperous suburban communities.
demographics: Cypress Towne Center serves an affluent suburban Houston market with median household incomes ranging from $98,000 to $133,000 within a 3-mile radius. The primary trade area consists of growing families and upper-middle-class households, with average household incomes exceeding $167,000 in the immediate vicinity. The center attracts a diverse mix of suburban shoppers seeking convenient access to national retailers, services, and dining options along the busy US Highway 290 corridor.
description: Cypress Towne Center is a premier open-air shopping destination strategically located along US Highway 290 in the rapidly growing northwest Houston suburb of Cypress, Texas. Spanning 279,210 square feet of gross leasable area, this well-positioned community center serves one of Houston's most affluent and fastest-growing residential markets. The center is shadow-anchored by a high-performing Target store and features an excellent mix of national big-box retailers, specialty shops, restaurants, and service providers that cater to the daily needs of the surrounding community. With convenient access from Highway 290 and ample parking at a ratio of 5.04 spaces per 1,000 square feet, Cypress Towne Center offers shoppers easy accessibility and a comfortable shopping experience. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air shopping centers, the property benefits from professional management and strategic tenant curation that keeps it competitive in the dynamic Houston retail market.
